about_the_game:
Experience the world of Slime Tales before the full release!
This demo offers a glimpse into the early stages of your slimy adventure beneath Gandolf Gastor Griffin’s ancient castle — where restless spirits and forgotten magics begin to stir once again.

Explore a procedurally generated dungeon packed with dangerous enemies, hidden secrets, and the first taste of our roguelite combat system. Experiment with weapons, abilities, and upgrades to discover your favorite playstyle — every run offers something new!

Please remember: this demo represents an early version of the game and will continue to evolve as we polish performance, expand content, and refine balance. Your feedback plays a huge part in shaping the final experience — we’d love to hear what you think!

💬 Share your thoughts:
Join our Steam Discussions to leave feedback, bug reports, or ideas.

💚 Enjoyed the demo?
Don’t miss the full adventure — Wishlist Slime Tales on Steam to follow development and get notified at launch!
